name: Full Moon Mafia
source:
You’re on your way home, full moon lighting your way, when you’re suddenly attacked by a wolf-like creature leaving you with a nasty bite. But before it can cause any further damage, you’re saved by two handsome men, who also seem to be part wolf! You quickly recognize them as part of the local mob, the Bloodhounds.

Realizing the seriousness of your bite, they take you back to their boss, who tells you you’ve been marked by a leader of a rival gang. He offers you protection and help in exchange for using you as bait. Between all the turf wars, money disputes, and fangs, can you find love with a werewolf mobster… or will your mark turn you into a wolf instead?

Prepare for a dangerous affair in Full Moon Mafia!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.wolfgangs]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你正在回家的路上，满月照亮了你的路，突然你被一只像狼一样的生物袭击了，被咬了一口。但在它造成任何进一步的伤害之前，两个英俊的男人救了你，他们似乎也有狼的部分！你很快就认出他们是当地暴徒“寻血犬”的一部分。

意识到你咬伤的严重性后，他们把你带回他们的老板那里，老板告诉你，你已经被敌对帮派的头目标记了。他为你提供保护和帮助，以换取使用你作为诱饵。在所有的地盘争夺、金钱纠纷和毒牙之间，你能找到与狼人黑帮的爱情吗……或者你的标记会把你变成狼吗？

准备好迎接满月黑手党的危险事件吧！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.wolfgangs]Google Play[/url]]
